subject: Post-call: validate monthly token range, $/1M target & PO thresholds
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Dec 02 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — quick check on monthly band & $/1M target

Hi Liam — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and two asks so we can produce a clean estimate: 

1) Monthly consumption band: you mentioned a likely starting corridor of ~40–120M tokens/month for the initial pilot (mainly search+routing + 1:1 responses). Can you confirm whether that range is accurate, or whether we should center the estimate around 60–80M instead?

2) Procurement threshold and PO timing: finance hinted at a $50k PO floor for SaaS purchases and a 30-day review window — is that correct? If there's a different internal threshold (e.g., $100k) please flag.

For transparency, our ballpark unit economics (untiered) for the model profile we demoed: $1,200 / 1M tokens for the base variant; aggressive banding and reserved capacity can reduce that to $650–$800 / 1M at higher commits. We'll send a worked example once the band is confirmed.

Next steps I propose: you confirm the monthly band and PO floor, I circulate an updated pricing worksheet + mutual action plan for signatures. Can we aim to lock those by EOD Thursday so legal can start a review next week?

Attachment: call-recording-notes.txt (text summary)

Thanks —
Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@brightbridge.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Dec 03 2026 09:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick check on monthly band & $/1M target

Hey Dylan — appreciate the recap. Confirming the high-level items from my side:

- Monthly consumption: the 40–120M band is the right way to size the pilot. Our most likely initial scenario is ~70M tokens/month (search + customer summaries), but spike risk during onboarding could push towards the upper end briefly.
- Procurement/PO: finance set an informal $75k review threshold for cloud/AI services; anything above that will need a formal PO and procurement lead time of ~4–6 weeks. Below $75k we can often use a credit card via our procurement router.

If you can put together a pricing worksheet that shows unit econ at 40 / 70 / 120M with both on-demand and committed tiers, that would help our procurement and product teams choose a path. Also include a 6-month ramp scenario and the estimated breakpoints where reserved pricing applies.

We'd like the mutual action plan so internal stakeholders can see milestones and the playbook for legal/infosec. A PDF is fine.

Best —
Liam Carter
Head of AI Products, BrightBridge AI
liam.carter@brightbridge.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Dec 04 2026 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightBridge confirmation — pricing worksheet ask (FF: procurement thresholds)

Irene / Naomi — forwarding Liam's confirmation from BrightBridge. Key asks: pricing worksheet that shows 40 / 70 / 120M monthly examples, both on-demand and 3- and 12-month committed tiers; also include token-level $/1M breakpoints and an ops bullet on expected latency SLAs per tier.

Procurement note from Liam: $75k informal PO threshold; >$75k requires 4–6 week review. That will drive our recommended initial commit.

Can Naomi please produce the XLS with the worked examples? Irene, can you confirm any legal turn-times we should call out on the mutual action plan (esp. SLA/DPAs)? I expect we should propose a 6-week legal/infosec review in the MAP to be conservative.

Attachments to prepare when we reply to the customer:
- RBW-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx (pricing table + worked 3 scenarios)
- MutualActionPlan-BrightBridge.pdf (milestones + legal/infosec gating)

Thanks —
Dylan

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 09 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Pricing worksheet + MAP attached — next steps and PO guidance

Hi Liam — attaching the two items you asked for:

- RBW-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx (attached) — contains worked examples for 40 / 70 / 120M tokens per month with three pricing lines: on-demand, 3-month reserve, and 12-month reserve. The sheet shows per-1M token unit costs and monthly totals. Short summary: at ~70M/month, on-demand estimate is ~$84k/month (~$1,200 / 1M). A conservative 3-month reserve drops unit cost to ~$760 / 1M and a 12-month reserve to ~$660 / 1M.
- MutualActionPlan-BrightBridge.pdf (attached) — outlines milestones for pilot kickoff, security review, contract, and go-live. We explicitly call out a 4–6 week procurement window for PO > $75k based on your note, and a suggested legal/infosec review window of 6 weeks.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm which scenario (40 / 70 / 120M) to base the pilot on — we can then finalize the quote line items for finance.
- If you need a PO > $75k, confirm the internal approvers and preferred DocuSign contact so we can route the contract.
- If you want to accelerate, we can provision a short-term reserved pool for 30 days (soft commit) to control unit economics while legal finishes procurement.

Attachment stubs: RBW-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx (XLSX), MutualActionPlan-BrightBridge.pdf (PDF)

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the spreadsheet — available Wed/Thu next week.

Best regards,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192
